title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, pursuant to G.L. Chapter 164, Sec. 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell up to 34,000 shares of common capital stock, $25 par value, at not less than par; to issue, on a negotiated basis, unsecured long-term debt in an aggregate principal amount of up to $10,000,000; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, sec. 15.
